description: Source code for a report class that generates BVR payment vector reports in an Odoo module, including methods for file handling, formatting, and reference generation.

classes.name: AccountInvoiceBvr
classes.description: Report class for printing BVR payment vector, extending report_sxw.rml_parse

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, sets up context and copies OCRB font file

methods.name: police_absolute_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the OCRB font file based on script location

methods.name: copyocrbfile
methods.description: Copies the OCRB font file to /tmp directory if not already present

methods.name: comma_me
methods.description: Formats a number with Swiss comma notation

methods.name: _space
methods.description: Inserts spaces into a number string for formatting

methods.name: _get_ref
methods.description: Generates a BVR/ESR reference number from an invoice object
